meta.title: Alterations & Returns | Thiên Canh
meta.description: Free fit adjustments, size exchanges, returns and seam warranty at Thiên Canh — send a request online with just your order code.

title: Alterations & Returns
subtitle: Our work doesn't end when the áo dài leaves the shop. If it doesn't fit quite right, needs another size, or a seam comes loose, send it back — our tailors will stitch until you're happy.

ALTERATION.title: Alterations
ALTERATION.short: Adjust waist, bust, hem or sleeves for a better fit
ALTERATION.description: Take in the waist, ease the bust, shorten the hem or adjust sleeves until it fits. The first adjustment is free, including made-to-measure pieces.
ALTERATION.scope: Applies to: every áo dài bought from us

EXCHANGE.title: Size / style exchange
EXCHANGE.short: Swap for another size, colour or style
EXCHANGE.description: Swap for another size, colour or style at the same price or pay the difference. We cover return shipping when the fault is ours.

RETURN.title: Returns
RETURN.short: Refund when the item isn't as described
RETURN.description: Refunded to your account within 3–5 business days after we receive and inspect the item.

WARRANTY.title: Seam warranty
WARRANTY.short: Loose seams, broken buttons / zips, loose embroidery
WARRANTY.description: Loose seams, broken buttons or zips, lost beads or loosened hand embroidery — repaired free of charge, no questions asked.
WARRANTY.scope: Applies to: every piece, including made-to-measure

conditions.tags: Items for exchange / return must keep their tags, be unwashed, unironed and odour-free.
conditions.unworn: Alterations and warranty repairs accept worn pieces — just make sure they're clean.
conditions.receipt: Time limits count from the delivery date; we match by order code, no paper receipt needed.
conditions.custom: Made-to-measure pieces can't be exchanged or returned, but are always altered and repaired.

request.heading: Three steps, under two minutes
request.intro: Enter your order code so we know which piece needs care — no sign-in required.
request.notEligible: This order is currently “{status}”. Alteration and return requests open once you've received your order.

lookup.title: Verify your order
lookup.description: Your order code is in the confirmation email / SMS, formatted TC-YYMM-XXXX.
lookup.contact: Phone or email used to order
lookup.privacyNote: Used only to verify your order — your address and measurements are never shown.

choose.title: Choose item & request type
choose.description: One request per item — send another afterwards for more items.

detail.title: Details & hand-over
detail.description: The more specific you are, the better our tailors can prepare — photos of the issue help a lot.

placeholder.ALTERATION: E.g. waist is about 2cm too loose, the hem is 3cm longer than I'd like…
placeholder.EXCHANGE: E.g. I'd like size L instead of M, same colour…
placeholder.RETURN: E.g. the fabric is darker than in the photos…
placeholder.WARRANTY: E.g. the left underarm seam has come loose by about 3cm…

detail.handoverLabel: How will you send it to us?
detail.responseNote: We'll call to confirm within 24 business hours.

STORE.title: Bring it to the shop
STORE.description: Our tailor re-measures and may adjust it on the spot — fastest.

POST.title: Send by post
POST.description: We'll send packing instructions; shipping is on us when the fault is ours.

SUBMIT.title: Send a request
SUBMIT.description: You get a request code right away.

CONFIRM.title: We call to confirm
CONFIRM.description: Within 24 business hours a tailor asks for details and books a time.

HANDOVER.title: Hand the piece over
HANDOVER.description: Bring it to the showroom or post it following our guide.

DONE.title: Done & returned
DONE.description: Alterations take 3–5 days; exchanges / refunds follow inspection.

help.description: Can't find your order code, or want to ask first? Drop us a message.

success.title: We've received your request
success.description: A Thiên Canh tailor will call within 24 business hours to confirm and arrange a time. Please keep the request code below.
